theme: hybrid (light landing page, light/dark app panels, dark cinematic sections)

fonts.name: Playfair Display
fonts.usage: H1, H2, large quotes, branding text

fonts.name: Manrope
fonts.usage: General body copy, UI text, buttons

fonts.name: JetBrains Mono
fonts.usage: Usage meters, quotas, code blocks, technical stats, LoopStrip marquee

colors.rules: DO NOT INTRODUCE NEW COLORS. Maintain the exact current palette. Use golden_hour for primary interactions, iris_ai ONLY for AI features (Video Gen, Social Studio).

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-cinema_ivory/70 border-b border-lumiere_ink/5 (light) or bg-lumiere_ink/60 border-b border-warm_white/10 (dark)
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid (light: border-lumiere_ink/10, dark: border-warm_white/10). No soft muddy shadows.
visual_enhancers.marquee: LoopStrip marquee: JetBrains Mono text, slow scroll, uppercase. Colors depend on light/dark mode section.
visual_enhancers.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary: bg-golden_hour text-white hover:bg-golden_hour/90. AI Action: bg-iris_ai text-white hover:bg-iris_ai/90. Secondary: border border-lumiere_ink text-lumiere_ink hover:bg-lumiere_ink/5.
visual_enhancers.cards: Subtle border, max 12px border-radius (rounded-xl). Padding p-6 or p-8.

component_instructions.navigation: Glassmorphism nav header. Logo left, Links center (Studio, Agent, Pricing), Language toggle & Sign In right.
component_instructions.buttons: Follow button visual rules. Add data-testid to every interactive button.
component_instructions.inputs: Use Shadcn components. Style to match editorial theme (rounded-xl, subtle borders, focus:ring-golden_hour or focus:ring-iris_ai for AI).
component_instructions.tables: For Admin Panel, use clean minimal tables with JetBrains Mono for metrics and IDs.
component_instructions.tabs: For Admin Panel, use pill-like or clean underline tabs.

landing_page.hero: Asymmetric two-column. Left: Playfair headline 'You live it. LUMIÈRE directs it.', subtitle, primary CTA. Right: cinematic video/image card with play button & floating search pill.
landing_page.narrative_gap: Centered heading. Two contrasting cards: one light image-card (bullets), one dark card (AI features with icons, Iris AI accents).
landing_page.capture_to_cinema: Numbered workflow steps on left (JetBrains Mono numbers), laptop image on right.
landing_page.narrative_copilots: Grid of 3 team/agent cards with portraits, minimal borders.
landing_page.dark_band: Full-width DARK band (bg-lumiere_ink). 'Detecting what's missing before it's gone', large bold text, device visual.
landing_page.speak_cinema: Split layout. Overlaid bilingual quote boxes.
landing_page.pricing: Studio Membership. 3 tiers (Free, Creator, Studio), monthly-yearly toggle. Highlight Creator.
landing_page.footer: Full-width dark final CTA card + Google sign-in. Multi-column links.

layouts.studio_dashboard: Light mode. Welcome, active experience/continue, create-new CTA, recent grid. Plan & usage meters (JetBrains Mono).
layouts.ai_video_generator: Light base, Iris AI accents. Prompt input, options (model/aspect/duration). 'Generate' button (Iris AI). Jobs list (pending, processing, done). Dark cinematic video monitor for playback. Show plan gating.
layouts.ai_social_studio: Studio-plan exclusive. Iris AI accents. Input brief -> AI proposes plan -> List of posts (copy, image preview, network selector, schedule picker). Calendar view. Status chips.
layouts.admin_panel: Tabbed CMS. Sections: plans/pricing editing, landing content editing, users list, video jobs monitor, scheduled posts monitor. Premium, on-brand look.
layouts.account: Light mode. Profile, plan, usage, settings, privacy, sign out. No video players.

spacing: Generous spacing. p-12, p-16, p-24 for section padding. gap-8 to gap-16 in grids.
motion: Framer Motion staggered reveals. Slow, cinematic entrances. 'Projection room' transition when crossing light to dark routes (a quick wipe or fade through dark).
instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts from Google Fonts: Playfair Display, Manrope, JetBrains Mono.
Configure tailwind.config.js with the exact custom colors provided (cinema_ivory, warm_white, lumiere_ink, golden_hour, sage_film, iris_ai). Do not use default slate or zinc.
Implement the UI using Shadcn but heavily override styling to match this specific editorial/cinematic look (thin borders, specific radiuses, generous padding).
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Implement the LoopStrip marquee using react-fast-marquee or CSS animation. It should read: INTENT → STORY → DIRECT → CAPTURE → UNDERSTAND → EVALUATE → DETECT GAP → GET THE SHOT
For the Video Generator, the AI prompt and generate flow is simulated UI for Vertex AI, highlight AI with iris_ai color.
For the Social Content Studio, build a complex layout combining post generation, image preview, scheduling, and network selection. Restrict access visually based on Studio plan.
Use Phosphor icons or Lucide icons.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use asymmetry and generous spacing.
Create depth through layered design elements. Use glass-morphism effects.
NEVER apply universal transition (transition: all). Add specific transitions.
NEVER center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Use modern pill-shaped or subtle rounded buttons.
NEVER use emojis for icons. Use proper icon libraries.
Include hover states and micro-animations for all interactive elements.
Do not guess or placeholder image URLs. Use the provided URLs.
